A '''K4 security droid''' was part of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] contingent assigned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during its [[DarkStryder Campaign|mission]] to track [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] through the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. One of six K4 units stationed aboard, it was assigned to guard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the K4's programming was subverted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[the Wraith]]. Fitted with a miniature [[Dart gun/Legends|dart gun]] loaded with a [[Poison/Legends|poison]]-coated [[Dart/Legends|dart]], the droid attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]] during the [[Battle of Galtea]].
